rows.text: with word filters H = the 32 bytes at `01CDC060` + 32*argument 3 and V = those at `01CDC060` + 32*argument 4 (every rounding adds 64 from `03001000` and shifts right 7, arithmetic, and results are packed to bytes with unsigned saturation), it writes 16 rows of 16 bytes with aligned stores to argument 5, rows dword argument 6 apart, reading argument 1 with rows dword argument 2 apart (both sign-extended): when argument 3 is 0, each output row is (r*V0 + r_next*V1 + 64) >> 7 over two consecutive source rows; else when argument 4 is 0, each is (s[j]*H0 + s[j+1]*H1 + 64) >> 7 along one source row; otherwise each source row from the first is filtered horizontally to bytes h, and each output row is (h_previous*V0 + h*V1 + 64) >> 7; it saves and restores `xmm6`/`xmm7`
